questions.subtopic: Goodwill With NCI Measured at Fair Value
questions.stem: On July 1, Year 3, Norland Corp. paid $8,400,000 cash for 70% of the voting shares of Pike Co. and paid $250,000 of legal fees. The fair value of the 30% noncontrolling interest was $3,300,000. Pike's identifiable assets and liabilities had fair values of $13,900,000 and $3,400,000, respectively. What amount of goodwill should Norland recognize?
questions.explanation: Under ASC 805, goodwill equals the consideration transferred plus the acquisition-date fair value of the noncontrolling interest, minus the fair value of identifiable net assets. Identifiable net assets are $13,900,000 - $3,400,000 = $10,500,000. Goodwill = $8,400,000 + $3,300,000 - $10,500,000 = $1,200,000. The $1,050,000 amount compares only the parent's consideration with 70% of net assets (partial goodwill), which U.S. GAAP does not permit because NCI is measured at fair value. The $1,450,000 amount adds the legal fees to consideration; acquisition-related costs are expensed as incurred. The $1,300,000 amount combines the partial-goodwill error with the legal fees.
questions.explanationJa: ASC 805では、のれん＝移転対価＋非支配持分の取得日公正価値－識別可能純資産の公正価値。識別可能純資産は$13,900,000－$3,400,000＝$10,500,000。のれん＝$8,400,000＋$3,300,000－$10,500,000＝$1,200,000。$1,050,000は親会社の対価と純資産の70%だけを比べた部分のれんで、非支配持分を公正価値で測定する米国基準では認められない。$1,450,000は弁護士報酬を対価に加えているが、取得関連費用は発生時に費用処理する。$1,300,000は部分のれんの誤りに弁護士報酬を加えた額。

questions.subtopic: Step Acquisition - Gain and Goodwill
questions.stem: Ardent Inc. held a 20% equity-method interest in Bray Co. carried at $1,100,000, then paid $4,800,000 for another 60%, obtaining control. At that date, the 20% interest was worth $1,600,000, the noncontrolling interest $1,600,000, and Bray's identifiable net assets $7,200,000. What should Ardent recognize?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Gain of $500,000; goodwill of $800,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: No gain; goodwill of $300,000

choices.label: C
choices.text: Gain of $500,000; goodwill of $300,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: No gain; goodwill of $800,000, with $500,000 credited to APIC

questions.explanation: In a business combination achieved in stages, the acquirer remeasures its previously held equity interest to acquisition-date fair value and recognizes the difference in earnings: $1,600,000 - $1,100,000 = $500,000 gain. Goodwill = consideration transferred $4,800,000 + fair value of previously held interest $1,600,000 + fair value of NCI $1,600,000 - identifiable net assets $7,200,000 = $800,000. The $300,000 goodwill amounts use the $1,100,000 carrying amount of the old interest instead of its fair value. Crediting the remeasurement to additional paid-in capital is incorrect; obtaining control is a remeasurement event recognized in earnings, not a transaction with owners.
questions.explanationJa: 段階取得では、取得企業は既存持分を取得日の公正価値で再測定し、差額を損益に計上する：$1,600,000－$1,100,000＝$500,000の利得。のれん＝移転対価$4,800,000＋既存持分の公正価値$1,600,000＋非支配持分の公正価値$1,600,000－識別可能純資産$7,200,000＝$800,000。のれん$300,000の組み合わせは、既存持分を公正価値ではなく帳簿価額$1,100,000で計算している。再測定差額を資本剰余金に計上するのは誤り。支配の獲得は損益に計上する再測定の契機であり、株主との資本取引ではない。

questions.subtopic: Measurement Period Adjustment - Presentation
questions.stem: Corwin Co. acquired Lyle Inc. on October 1, Year 1, recording Lyle's equipment at a provisional value. In May, Year 2, an appraisal of conditions at the acquisition date raised the equipment's fair value by $400,000. How should Corwin reflect this?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Restate Year 1 for the higher equipment value and related depreciation

choices.label: B
choices.text: Adjust equipment and goodwill in Year 2, including catch-up depreciation since the acquisition date

choices.label: C
choices.text: Increase equipment and recognize a $400,000 gain in Year 2

choices.label: D
choices.text: Adjust equipment and goodwill in Year 2, depreciating the increase only from May forward

questions.explanation: The appraisal reflects facts that existed at the acquisition date and was obtained within one year, so it is a measurement period adjustment. The offset is to goodwill. Under ASU 2015-16, the acquirer records the adjustment in the period it is determined (Year 2) and includes in that period's earnings the cumulative effect of depreciation as if the adjustment had been made at the acquisition date. Restating Year 1 was the prior requirement and is no longer permitted. A gain is incorrect because the adjustment changes the purchase price allocation, not earnings. Depreciating only from May forward ignores the required catch-up of depreciation from October 1, Year 1.
questions.explanationJa: 鑑定は取得日に存在した事実を反映し、1年以内に得られているため、測定期間の修正に当たる。相手勘定はのれん。ASU 2015-16により、修正は判明した期（Year 2）に計上し、取得日に修正済みだったとした場合の減価償却の累積影響をその期の損益に含める。Year 1の修正再表示は旧基準の扱いで、現在は認められない。利得計上は誤り。修正は取得価額の配分を変えるもので損益ではない。5月以降だけ償却する処理は、Year 1の10月1日からの償却の追いつき計上を無視している。

questions.subtopic: VIE - Characteristics of Equity Holders
questions.stem: Which circumstance, by itself, causes a legal entity to be a variable interest entity?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Its equity investment at risk equals 12% of its total assets

choices.label: B
choices.text: It is financed partly with subordinated debt from an unrelated lender

choices.label: C
choices.text: Its activities are conducted mainly for the investor holding most of its votes

choices.label: D
choices.text: Its equity investors are protected from expected losses by the lender's guarantee

questions.explanation: A legal entity is a VIE if its equity investors, as a group, lack any of the characteristics of a controlling financial interest, including the obligation to absorb expected losses. Equity holders protected by a guarantee from another party involved with the entity lack that obligation. Equity at risk of 12% of total assets is not determinative; the 10% figure is only a rebuttable presumption about sufficiency, and meeting it does not create VIE status. Subordinated debt financing alone does not make an entity a VIE. Activities conducted on behalf of an investor trigger VIE status only when that investor has disproportionately few voting rights, not when it holds most of them.
questions.explanationJa: 法的実体は、持分投資者全体が支配的財務持分の特性（予想損失を負担する義務を含む）のいずれかを欠くときVIEとなる。実体に関与する他者の保証で損失から守られている持分投資者は、その義務を欠く。リスク負担持分が総資産の12%というだけでは判断できない。10%は十分性に関する反証可能な推定にすぎず、それを満たしてもVIEにはならない。劣後債による資金調達だけではVIEにならない。ある投資者のための活動がVIEの要件になるのは、その投資者の議決権が不釣り合いに少ない場合であり、議決権の大半を持つ場合ではない。

questions.subtopic: VIE - Timing of Primary Beneficiary Assessment
questions.stem: Fenwick Corp. holds a variable interest in Orchard LLC, which is a variable interest entity. How often must Fenwick reassess whether it is Orchard's primary beneficiary?

choices.label: A
choices.text: On an ongoing basis, at each reporting period

choices.label: B
choices.text: Only when a reconsideration event changes Orchard's status as a VIE

choices.label: C
choices.text: Only on the date Fenwick first becomes involved with Orchard

choices.label: D
choices.text: Only when Fenwick's share of Orchard's voting interests exceeds 50%

questions.explanation: A reporting entity with a variable interest in a VIE must continuously reassess whether it is the primary beneficiary. Reconsideration events govern a different question: whether the legal entity itself is still (or has become) a VIE. Assessing only at initial involvement ignores changes in power or economics after that date. Voting-interest percentages do not drive the primary beneficiary test, which depends on power over the most significant activities and exposure to potentially significant losses or benefits.
questions.explanationJa: VIEに変動持分を持つ報告企業は、自らが主たる受益者かどうかを継続的に再評価しなければならない。再検討事象（reconsideration event）は別の論点、つまり法的実体がVIEのままか（VIEになったか）の判断に用いる。当初関与時だけ評価する考え方は、その後の権限や経済性の変化を無視している。主たる受益者の判定は、最も重要な活動を指図する権限と、重要となり得る損失・便益へのエクスポージャーで決まり、議決権割合では決まらない。

questions.subtopic: NCI Income With Unrealized Upstream Land Gain
questions.stem: Sable Corp. owns 70% of Tern Co. During Year 2, Tern sold land costing $90,000 to Sable for $140,000; Sable still holds the land at year end. Tern reported Year 2 net income of $400,000, and Sable reported $600,000 of income from its own operations. What amount of consolidated net income is attributable to the noncontrolling interest?
questions.explanation: The sale is upstream (subsidiary to parent), so the unrealized gain of $140,000 - $90,000 = $50,000 is eliminated from Tern's income, and the elimination is shared with the noncontrolling interest. NCI = 30% x ($400,000 - $50,000) = $105,000. The $120,000 amount ignores the unrealized gain, which would be correct only for a downstream sale. The $135,000 amount adds the gain instead of removing it. The $70,000 amount charges the entire $50,000 elimination to the NCI rather than its 30% share. Sable's $600,000 of separate income is irrelevant to the NCI computation.
questions.explanationJa: 子会社から親会社への販売（アップストリーム）なので、未実現利益$140,000－$90,000＝$50,000をTernの利益から消去し、その消去は非支配持分にも按分する。非支配持分＝30%×（$400,000－$50,000）＝$105,000。$120,000は未実現利益を無視しており、ダウンストリーム販売の場合にのみ正しい。$135,000は利益を控除せず加算している。$70,000は消去額$50,000の全額を非支配持分に負担させており、30%相当ではない。Sableの単体利益$600,000は非支配持分の計算に関係しない。

questions.subtopic: Purchase of Additional Interest - Effect on Total Equity
questions.stem: Garnet Corp. owns 60% of Lisle Co. and buys another 10% from noncontrolling shareholders for $900,000 cash. The carrying amount of the noncontrolling interest acquired is $1,000,000. What is the effect on Garnet's total consolidated equity?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Increase of $100,000 from a gain

choices.label: B
choices.text: Decrease of $1,000,000, equal to the NCI eliminated

choices.label: C
choices.text: Decrease of $900,000, with APIC increasing $100,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: No change, because the transaction is between owners

questions.explanation: A change in a parent's ownership interest while it retains control is an equity transaction. The NCI is reduced by its $1,000,000 carrying amount, and the $100,000 difference between that amount and the $900,000 paid is credited to the parent's additional paid-in capital. Total consolidated equity therefore falls by the $900,000 of cash paid to owners outside the consolidated group. No gain is recognized in earnings. The $1,000,000 decrease ignores the offsetting APIC credit. Total equity does change, because cash leaves the consolidated entity even though the transaction is with owners.
questions.explanationJa: 支配を維持したままの持分変動は資本取引である。非支配持分を帳簿価額$1,000,000だけ減らし、支払額$900,000との差額$100,000を親会社の資本剰余金に貸方計上する。したがって連結純資産合計は、連結グループ外の株主へ支払った現金$900,000だけ減少する。損益に利得は計上しない。$1,000,000の減少は資本剰余金の貸方を無視している。株主との取引であっても現金が連結実体から流出するため、純資産合計は変動する。

questions.subtopic: Derivative Definition - Applying the Three Characteristics
questions.stem: Which contract meets all three characteristics of a derivative under ASC 815?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A prepaid forward on 10,000 listed shares, fully paid at inception

choices.label: B
choices.text: A fixed-price contract for a custom-built machine, with no net settlement provision

choices.label: C
choices.text: A fixed-rate loan receivable acquired at its full principal amount

choices.label: D
choices.text: A fixed-price forward to buy 5,000 ounces of gold, settled by physical delivery

questions.explanation: A derivative has (1) an underlying and a notional amount, (2) no or a smaller-than-usual initial net investment, and (3) net settlement. The gold forward has an underlying (gold price) and notional (5,000 ounces), requires no initial investment, and is net settled in substance because gold is readily convertible to cash, even though delivery is physical. The prepaid forward fails the initial net investment test because the full price is paid up front. The custom machine contract lacks net settlement: there is no net settlement provision and the asset is not readily convertible to cash. The loan receivable requires an initial investment equal to its principal, so it fails the initial net investment criterion.
questions.explanationJa: デリバティブは、(1)原資産変数と想定元本、(2)当初純投資がないか通常より小さい、(3)純額決済、の3要件を満たすもの。金の先渡契約は原資産変数（金価格）と想定元本（5,000オンス）があり、当初投資は不要で、現物受渡しでも金は容易に現金化できるため実質的に純額決済に当たる。前払先渡契約は代金全額を当初に支払うため当初純投資の要件を満たさない。特注機械の契約は純額決済条項がなく、資産も容易に現金化できないため純額決済の要件を欠く。貸付金は元本相当の当初投資が必要なので当初純投資の要件を満たさない。

questions.subtopic: Hedge Designation - Foreign Currency Firm Commitment
questions.stem: Lowell Inc., a U.S.-dollar functional currency company, has an unrecognized firm commitment to buy machinery for CHF 2,000,000 in nine months and buys CHF forward to hedge the currency risk. Which hedge designation is permitted?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Either a fair value hedge or a cash flow hedge

choices.label: B
choices.text: A fair value hedge only, because the commitment is firm

choices.label: C
choices.text: A cash flow hedge only, because the purchase has not occurred

choices.label: D
choices.text: Neither, because unrecognized firm commitments cannot be hedged

questions.explanation: ASC 815 allows the foreign currency exposure of an unrecognized firm commitment to be hedged either as a fair value hedge (of changes in the commitment's fair value attributable to exchange rates) or as a foreign currency cash flow hedge (of the variability in the dollar cash flows of the commitment). For other risks, a firm commitment is hedged only through a fair value hedge, which is why the fair-value-only view is a common confusion. The cash-flow-only view wrongly treats the commitment as merely forecasted. Unrecognized firm commitments are explicitly eligible hedged items.
questions.explanationJa: ASC 815では、未認識の確定約定の為替リスクを、公正価値ヘッジ（為替による約定の公正価値変動のヘッジ）とキャッシュ・フロー・ヘッジ（約定のドル建てキャッシュ・フローの変動のヘッジ）のどちらでもヘッジできる。為替以外のリスクでは確定約定は公正価値ヘッジでしかヘッジできないため、「公正価値ヘッジのみ」とする誤解が起きやすい。「キャッシュ・フロー・ヘッジのみ」は約定を単なる予定取引として扱っている。未認識の確定約定は明示的にヘッジ対象として適格である。

questions.subtopic: Hedged Item Eligibility - Forecasted Transactions
questions.stem: Which item can be the hedged item in a cash flow hedge in a parent's consolidated financial statements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A forecasted business combination with an unrelated company

choices.label: B
choices.text: A forecasted issuance of the parent's own common stock

choices.label: C
choices.text: Foreign currency risk of a forecasted intercompany royalty payment

choices.label: D
choices.text: A forecasted purchase of subsidiary shares from noncontrolling shareholders

questions.explanation: Forecasted intercompany transactions denominated in a foreign currency can be hedged items for foreign currency risk in consolidated statements, because the exchange rate exposure ultimately affects consolidated earnings. A forecasted business combination is specifically excluded. Transactions in the entity's own equity, including issuing common stock or acquiring a subsidiary's shares from noncontrolling shareholders, are also excluded because they do not affect earnings.
questions.explanationJa: 外貨建ての予定グループ内取引は、為替エクスポージャーが最終的に連結損益に影響するため、連結財務諸表上で為替リスクのヘッジ対象にできる。予定された企業結合は明示的に対象外。自社の普通株式の発行や、子会社株式を非支配株主から買い取るといった自己の資本に関する取引も、損益に影響しないため対象外である。

questions.subtopic: Cash Flow Hedge - Amount Recorded in OCI After ASU 2017-12
questions.stem: Grady Co. designated a pay-fixed, receive-variable interest rate swap as a cash flow hedge of its variable-rate debt. The hedge is highly effective, and no components are excluded from the effectiveness assessment. During Year 1, the swap's fair value increased $46,000, while the present value of the hedged interest payments increased $41,000. What amount should Grady record in OCI?
questions.explanation: Under ASC 815 as amended by ASU 2017-12, for a highly effective cash flow hedge the entire change in fair value of the hedging instrument included in the effectiveness assessment ($46,000) is recorded in OCI and later reclassified into earnings when the hedged interest payments affect earnings. Ineffectiveness is no longer measured and recognized separately. The $41,000 amount applies the superseded 'lesser of' approach, under which an overhedge was recognized in earnings. The $5,000 amount is that former ineffectiveness amount. Recording nothing in OCI would be correct only if the swap were not designated as a hedge.
questions.explanationJa: ASU 2017-12改正後のASC 815では、有効性の高いキャッシュ・フロー・ヘッジについて、有効性評価に含めたヘッジ手段の公正価値変動の全額（$46,000）をOCIに計上し、ヘッジ対象の利息支払が損益に影響する時点で損益へ組替える。非有効部分を区分して測定・認識する処理は廃止された。$41,000は旧来の「いずれか小さい額」の方法で、過剰ヘッジ部分を損益に計上していた。$5,000はその旧方式の非有効部分の額。OCIに何も計上しないのは、スワップをヘッジ指定していない場合だけ正しい。

questions.subtopic: Fair Value Hedge of Fixed-Rate Debt - Presentation
questions.stem: Prentice Corp. designated a receive-fixed, pay-variable swap as a fair value hedge of the benchmark interest rate risk of its fixed-rate bonds payable. Rates rose; the swap lost $30,000 of fair value, and the bonds' fair value attributable to the benchmark rate fell $30,000. How are these reported?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Both in interest expense, with the bonds' carrying amount reduced $30,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: Swap loss in OCI; bonds remain at amortized cost

choices.label: C
choices.text: Swap loss in other expense; bond adjustment in interest expense

choices.label: D
choices.text: Swap loss in interest expense; bonds remain at amortized cost

questions.explanation: In a fair value hedge, the derivative's gain or loss is recognized in earnings, and the hedged item's carrying amount is adjusted for the change in fair value attributable to the hedged risk, also in earnings. ASU 2017-12 requires both to be presented in the same income statement line item as the earnings effect of the hedged item, which is interest expense for debt. OCI is used for cash flow and net investment hedges, not fair value hedges. Reporting the swap loss and the basis adjustment in different line items violates the same-line presentation requirement. Leaving the bonds at amortized cost omits the required basis adjustment and leaves the swap loss unoffset.
questions.explanationJa: 公正価値ヘッジでは、デリバティブの損益を損益に計上し、ヘッジ対象の帳簿価額もヘッジ対象リスクに起因する公正価値変動だけ修正して損益に計上する。ASU 2017-12により、両者はヘッジ対象の損益影響と同じ損益計算書の表示科目（社債なら支払利息）に表示する。OCIを使うのはキャッシュ・フロー・ヘッジと純投資ヘッジであり、公正価値ヘッジではない。スワップ損失と帳簿価額修正を別の科目に表示するのは同一科目表示の要件に反する。社債を償却原価のまま据え置くと、必要な帳簿価額修正が欠け、スワップ損失が相殺されない。

questions.subtopic: Embedded Derivatives in Debt Hosts - Bifurcation
questions.stem: Halden Corp. issues U.S. dollar debt with the features below; no hybrid is carried at fair value through earnings. Which embedded feature must be bifurcated?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Interest indexed, without leverage, to the U.S. consumer price index

choices.label: B
choices.text: A rate step-up if Halden's own credit rating declines

choices.label: C
choices.text: A call at par on debt issued at par

choices.label: D
choices.text: Interest that varies with the price of crude oil

questions.explanation: An embedded feature is bifurcated when its economic characteristics are not clearly and closely related to the host, the hybrid is not measured at fair value through earnings, and a freestanding instrument with the same terms would be a derivative. A commodity-indexed interest feature has risks (crude oil prices) unrelated to a debt host, so it must be separated. Unleveraged inflation indexing tied to the currency's own economy is considered clearly and closely related to debt. Credit-sensitive payments based on the issuer's own creditworthiness are clearly and closely related. A call option at par on debt issued at par does not accelerate repayment of a significant premium or discount and is clearly and closely related.
questions.explanationJa: 組込デリバティブは、経済的特性が主契約と明確かつ密接に関連しておらず、複合商品が公正価値で損益測定されておらず、同条件の単独商品ならデリバティブに当たる場合に区分処理する。原油価格に連動する利息は負債の主契約と無関係なリスクなので区分が必要。その通貨の経済圏の物価指数にレバレッジなしで連動する利息は、負債と明確かつ密接に関連するとされる。発行体自身の信用力に連動する利息も明確かつ密接に関連する。額面発行の負債に付いた額面での期限前償還権は、多額のプレミアム・ディスカウントを早期に回収させるものではなく、明確かつ密接に関連する。

questions.subtopic: Functional Currency Indicators and Resulting Method
questions.stem: Kestrel Corp.'s Mexican subsidiary keeps its books in pesos. Its sales are mainly exports priced in U.S. dollars, most inputs come from Kestrel, and Kestrel finances it. How are its statements converted, and where are the differences reported?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Translated; OCI

choices.label: B
choices.text: Remeasured; OCI

choices.label: C
choices.text: Remeasured; net income

choices.label: D
choices.text: Translated; net income

questions.explanation: The sales price, sales market, expense, financing, and intercompany indicators all point to the U.S. dollar as the subsidiary's functional currency, because the subsidiary operates as an extension of the parent. Because the books are kept in pesos, which is not the functional currency, the statements are remeasured into U.S. dollars using the temporal method, and remeasurement gains and losses are reported in net income. Translation with differences in OCI applies when the local currency is the functional currency. Remeasurement differences are not deferred in OCI, and translation adjustments are not reported in net income.
questions.explanationJa: 販売価格、販売市場、費用、資金調達、グループ内取引の各指標がすべて米ドルを示しており、子会社は親会社の延長として営業しているため機能通貨は米ドル。帳簿は機能通貨でないペソで記録されているので、テンポラル法で米ドルに再測定し、再測定差額は当期純利益に計上する。換算してOCIに計上するのは、現地通貨が機能通貨の場合。再測定差額をOCIに繰り延べることはなく、換算調整額を当期純利益に計上することもない。

questions.subtopic: Translation Adjustment for the First Year
questions.stem: On January 1, Year 1, Moray Inc. formed a foreign subsidiary (functional currency FC) with FC 500,000 when the rate was $1.20. It earned FC 100,000 evenly in Year 1 and paid no dividends. The average rate was $1.25; the year-end rate was $1.30. What is the Year 1 translation adjustment?

choices.label: A
choices.text: $60,000 credit to OCI

choices.label: B
choices.text: $55,000 credit to OCI

choices.label: C
choices.text: $55,000 gain in net income

choices.label: D
choices.text: $50,000 credit to OCI

questions.explanation: Translated net assets at year end are FC 600,000 x $1.30 = $780,000. Contributed capital is translated at the historical rate (FC 500,000 x $1.20 = $600,000), and net income at the average rate (FC 100,000 x $1.25 = $125,000), totaling $725,000. The balancing amount, $780,000 - $725,000 = $55,000, is a favorable translation adjustment reported in OCI. The $60,000 amount applies the rate change only to the FC 500,000 of opening capital and ignores its effect on income earned. The $50,000 amount translates the income at the year-end rate rather than the average rate. Translation adjustments are not reported in net income.
questions.explanationJa: 期末の換算後純資産はFC 600,000×$1.30＝$780,000。払込資本は取得時レート（FC 500,000×$1.20＝$600,000）、当期純利益は期中平均レート（FC 100,000×$1.25＝$125,000）で換算し、合計$725,000。差額$780,000－$725,000＝$55,000が有利な換算調整額で、OCIに計上する。$60,000は期首の資本FC 500,000にだけレート変動を適用し、当期利益への影響を無視している。$50,000は利益を平均レートでなく期末レートで換算している。換算調整額は当期純利益には計上しない。

questions.subtopic: OCI Versus Net Income for Exchange Differences
questions.stem: Which exchange difference is reported in OCI rather than net income?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Adjustment from translating a euro-functional subsidiary's statements into dollars

choices.label: B
choices.text: Loss on a euro payable of a parent whose functional currency is the dollar

choices.label: C
choices.text: Gain from remeasuring a subsidiary's peso books into its dollar functional currency

choices.label: D
choices.text: Loss on an intercompany euro advance expected to be repaid within six months

questions.explanation: Translation adjustments arising from converting a foreign entity's functional currency statements into the reporting currency are reported in OCI and accumulated in equity. A foreign-currency payable creates a transaction gain or loss reported in net income. Remeasurement from books of record into the functional currency produces gains and losses in net income. An intercompany balance receives OCI treatment only when settlement is not planned or anticipated in the foreseeable future; an advance expected to be repaid within six months produces transaction gains and losses in net income.
questions.explanationJa: 在外事業体の機能通貨建て財務諸表を報告通貨に換算して生じる換算調整額はOCIに計上し、資本に累積する。外貨建て買掛金からは取引損益が生じ、当期純利益に計上する。帳簿通貨から機能通貨への再測定による損益は当期純利益に計上する。グループ内債権債務がOCI扱いになるのは、予見可能な将来に決済が計画も予想もされない場合だけで、6か月以内に返済予定の貸付金の為替差損益は当期純利益に計上する。

questions.subtopic: Highly Inflationary Economy - Required Approach
questions.stem: Arlo Corp. consolidates a subsidiary in a country whose cumulative three-year inflation exceeds 100%. How does U.S. GAAP require the subsidiary's statements to be converted?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Translate at the current rate, with adjustments in OCI

choices.label: B
choices.text: Restate for general price-level changes, then translate at the current rate

choices.label: C
choices.text: Translate at the current rate and disclose inflation effects in the notes

choices.label: D
choices.text: Remeasure into the reporting currency, with gains and losses in net income

questions.explanation: Under ASC 830, the financial statements of a foreign entity in a highly inflationary economy (cumulative three-year inflation of approximately 100% or more) are remeasured as if the functional currency were the reporting currency, and remeasurement gains and losses go to net income. This prevents nonmonetary assets from shrinking in reporting-currency terms as the local currency collapses. Translation at the current rate with adjustments in OCI is not permitted for such an entity. Price-level restatement followed by translation is the IFRS approach under IAS 29, not U.S. GAAP. Note disclosure does not replace the required change in method.
questions.explanationJa: ASC 830では、高インフレ経済（3年間の累積インフレ率がおおむね100%以上）にある在外事業体の財務諸表は、報告通貨が機能通貨であるものとして再測定し、再測定損益は当期純利益に計上する。現地通貨が暴落しても非貨幣性資産が報告通貨建てで目減りしないようにするためである。決算日レートで換算しOCIに計上する方法は、このような事業体には認められない。一般物価水準で修正再表示してから換算するのはIFRS（IAS 29）の方法で、米国基準ではない。注記開示は必要な方法の変更の代わりにならない。

questions.subtopic: Regulation S-K Item 10(e) - Non-GAAP Measures
questions.stem: Under Regulation S-K Item 10(e), what is required when a registrant presents a non-GAAP financial measure in its Form 10-K?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The measure must be audited and covered by the auditor's opinion

choices.label: B
choices.text: The measure must appear on the face of the income statement

choices.label: C
choices.text: GAAP measure given equal or greater prominence, with a reconciliation

choices.label: D
choices.text: The measure must be disclosed only in the notes to the financial statements

questions.explanation: Item 10(e) of Regulation S-K requires a registrant presenting a non-GAAP measure in an SEC filing to present the most directly comparable GAAP measure with equal or greater prominence and to provide a quantitative reconciliation, along with a statement of why management believes the measure is useful. Non-GAAP measures are not audited as part of the financial statements. Item 10(e) prohibits presenting non-GAAP measures on the face of the financial statements or in the accompanying notes, so the income statement and notes placements are both incorrect.
questions.explanationJa: Regulation S-KのItem 10(e)は、SEC提出書類で非GAAP指標を示す登録企業に、最も直接比較可能なGAAP指標を同等以上の目立ち方で示すこと、定量的な調整表を示すこと、経営者がその指標を有用と考える理由を記載することを求める。非GAAP指標は財務諸表の一部として監査されない。Item 10(e)は非GAAP指標を財務諸表本体や注記に示すことを禁止しているため、損益計算書や注記に載せるとする記述はいずれも誤り。

questions.subtopic: Form 10-Q - Accountant Involvement With Interim Statements
questions.stem: Under Regulation S-X, what involvement of an independent accountant is required for the interim financial statements included in a registrant's quarterly report on Form 10-Q?

choices.label: A
choices.text: An audit, because the statements are filed with the SEC

choices.label: B
choices.text: A review, completed before the report is filed

choices.label: C
choices.text: A compilation, because the statements are condensed

choices.label: D
choices.text: None, unless the registrant is a large accelerated filer

questions.explanation: Rule 10-01(d) of Regulation S-X requires the interim financial statements in Form 10-Q to be reviewed by an independent public accountant before filing, using applicable professional standards. They need not be audited, even though they are filed with the SEC. A compilation provides no assurance and does not satisfy the requirement; the condensed form of the statements does not change it. The review requirement applies to registrants generally, not only to large accelerated filers.
questions.explanationJa: Regulation S-XのRule 10-01(d)は、Form 10-Qの期中財務諸表について、提出前に独立した会計士が職業的基準に従ってレビューすることを求める。SECに提出するものでも監査は不要。コンピレーションは保証を与えず要件を満たさない。財務諸表が要約形式であっても要件は変わらない。レビュー要件は大規模早期提出会社に限らず登録企業一般に適用される。

questions.subtopic: Segment Reporting - Profit or Loss Test
questions.stem:
Corvo Inc. reports the following operating results for its five operating segments:
North | $900,000
South | $(300,000)
East | $150,000
West | $(600,000)
Central | $50,000
Which segments meet the ASC 280 profit or loss test?

choices.label: A
choices.text: North, South, East, and West

choices.label: B
choices.text: North and East only

choices.label: C
choices.text: North, South, and West only

choices.label: D
choices.text: All five segments

questions.explanation: The test compares each segment's absolute profit or loss with 10% of the greater, in absolute amount, of (1) combined profit of segments reporting a profit ($900,000 + $150,000 + $50,000 = $1,100,000) or (2) combined loss of segments reporting a loss ($900,000). The threshold is 10% x $1,100,000 = $110,000, so North, South, East, and West qualify; Central ($50,000) does not. Testing only the profitable segments ignores that losses are measured in absolute terms. Adding profits and losses together ($2,000,000) gives a $200,000 threshold that wrongly excludes East. Netting them ($200,000) gives a $20,000 threshold that wrongly includes Central.
questions.explanationJa: 利益・損失テストでは、各セグメントの利益または損失の絶対値を、(1)利益を計上したセグメントの利益合計（$900,000＋$150,000＋$50,000＝$1,100,000）と(2)損失を計上したセグメントの損失合計（$900,000）のうち絶対値の大きい方の10%と比べる。基準額は10%×$1,100,000＝$110,000なので、North・South・East・Westが該当し、Central（$50,000）は該当しない。利益のセグメントだけで判定すると、損失も絶対値で測ることを無視することになる。利益と損失を合算（$2,000,000）すると基準額$200,000となり、Eastを誤って除外する。相殺（$200,000）すると基準額$20,000となり、Centralを誤って含める。

questions.subtopic: XBRL - Linkbase Functions
questions.stem: In an XBRL filing, which component defines that the element for total current assets equals the sum of the individual current asset elements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The presentation linkbase

choices.label: B
choices.text: The label linkbase

choices.label: C
choices.text: The calculation linkbase

choices.label: D
choices.text: The instance document

questions.explanation: Taxonomy linkbases describe relationships among elements. The calculation linkbase defines additive (summation) relationships, such as individual current asset elements adding to total current assets, which allows the arithmetic of tagged data to be validated. The presentation linkbase controls the order and hierarchy in which elements are displayed, not their arithmetic. The label linkbase assigns human-readable labels to elements. The instance document contains the tagged facts reported for the period but does not define relationships among elements.
questions.explanationJa: タクソノミのリンクベースは要素間の関係を定義する。計算リンクベースは、個々の流動資産要素の合計が流動資産合計になるといった加算関係を定義し、タグ付けされたデータの計算整合性を検証できるようにする。表示リンクベースは要素を表示する順序と階層を定めるもので、計算関係ではない。ラベルリンクベースは要素に人が読める名称を付ける。インスタンス文書は当期に報告するタグ付きの事実を含むが、要素間の関係は定義しない。

questions.topic: Employee Benefit Plan Financial Statements (Area II)
questions.subtopic: Defined Contribution Plan - Net Increase in Net Assets
questions.stem:
Linden 401(k) Plan, a defined contribution plan, reports the following for Year 3:
Participant contributions | $820,000
Employer matching contributions | $410,000
Net appreciation in fair value of investments | $365,000
Interest and dividends | $95,000
Purchases of investments | $1,200,000
Benefits paid to participants | $640,000
Administrative expenses | $30,000
What is the net increase in net assets available for benefits?
questions.explanation: Additions are $820,000 + $410,000 + $365,000 + $95,000 = $1,690,000. Deductions are benefits paid $640,000 and administrative expenses $30,000, totaling $670,000. The net increase is $1,690,000 - $670,000 = $1,020,000. Purchases of investments exchange cash for investments and do not change net assets. The $1,050,000 amount omits administrative expenses. The $655,000 amount omits net appreciation, which is reported as an addition. The $1,660,000 amount fails to deduct benefits paid.
questions.explanationJa: 増加項目は$820,000＋$410,000＋$365,000＋$95,000＝$1,690,000。減少項目は給付支払$640,000と管理費用$30,000の計$670,000。純資産の純増加は$1,690,000－$670,000＝$1,020,000。投資の購入は現金と投資の交換で純資産を変えない。$1,050,000は管理費用を差し引いていない。$655,000は増加項目として表示する投資の公正価値の純増価を除いている。$1,660,000は給付支払を差し引いていない。

questions.topic: Employee Benefit Plan Financial Statements (Area II)
questions.subtopic: Defined Benefit Plan - Statement of Changes Versus Accumulated Benefits
questions.stem: Which of the following items is reported in a defined benefit pension plan's statement of changes in net assets available for benefits?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Increase in benefits attributable to a plan amendment

choices.label: B
choices.text: Interest resulting from the decrease in the discount period

choices.label: C
choices.text: Service cost for the year

choices.label: D
choices.text: Net appreciation in the fair value of plan investments

questions.explanation: The statement of changes in net assets available for benefits reports investment income (including net appreciation in fair value), contributions, benefits paid, and administrative expenses. Increases from a plan amendment and interest from the shorter discount period are factors that change the actuarial present value of accumulated plan benefits, which is presented in separate benefit information, not in the statement of changes in net assets. Service cost is a component of the sponsor's net periodic pension cost under ASC 715 and does not appear in the plan's own financial statements.
questions.explanationJa: 給付に充当可能な純資産の変動計算書には、投資収益（公正価値の純増価を含む）、拠出、給付支払、管理費用を表示する。制度改訂による増加や割引期間の短縮による利息は、累積給付の数理計算上の現在価値を変動させる要因で、純資産の変動計算書ではなく別の給付情報に表示する。勤務費用はASC 715に基づく事業主の期間年金費用の構成要素で、制度自体の財務諸表には表れない。

questions.subtopic: Lessor Classification — Variable Payments Causing a Day-One Loss
questions.stem: Rowe Leasing leases a machine for its entire remaining economic life. All rent is based on the lessee's sales, and sales-type classification would produce a selling loss at commencement. How should Rowe account for the lease?

choices.label: A
choices.text: As a sales-type lease, recognizing the loss at commencement

choices.label: B
choices.text: As an operating lease, recognizing rent as the lessee's sales occur

choices.label: C
choices.text: As a sales-type lease, including estimated rent in the net investment

choices.label: D
choices.text: As a direct financing lease, deferring the loss

questions.explanation: Under ASC 842-10-25-3A (added by ASU 2021-05), a lessor classifies a lease as an operating lease when (1) it would otherwise be classified as sales-type or direct financing, (2) it includes variable payments that do not depend on an index or rate, and (3) sales-type or direct financing classification would result in a selling loss at commencement. Rowe therefore keeps the machine on its balance sheet, continues to depreciate it, and recognizes the sales-based rent as income in the period the lessee's sales occur. Recognizing a day-one selling loss under sales-type accounting is exactly the result the amendment was designed to prevent. Sales-based variable payments are excluded from a lessor's net investment, so including estimated sales-based rent is not permitted. Direct financing classification is not available, and the guidance does not defer a loss; it requires operating lease treatment instead.
questions.explanationJa: ASC 842-10-25-3A（ASU 2021-05で追加）により、貸手は(1)本来なら販売型または直接金融リースに分類され、(2)指数・レートに連動しない変動リース料を含み、(3)販売型・直接金融に分類するとリース開始日に販売損失が生じる場合、オペレーティング・リースに分類する。したがってRoweは機械を貸借対照表に残して減価償却を続け、売上連動の賃料は借手の売上が発生した期間に収益認識する。販売型として開始日に損失を計上する処理は、まさにこの改正が防ごうとした結果である。売上連動の変動リース料は貸手の正味リース投資額に含めないため、見積額を含める処理は認められない。直接金融リースとして損失を繰り延べる処理もなく、オペレーティング・リースとして処理する。

questions.subtopic: Sales-Type Lease — Revenue With an Unguaranteed Residual
questions.stem: Kerr Manufacturing leases equipment it built under a sales-type lease. At commencement, the equipment's fair value is $600,000 and its carrying amount is $450,000. The present value of the lease payments is $560,000, and the present value of the unguaranteed residual asset is $40,000. What sales revenue should Kerr report at commencement?
questions.explanation: A manufacturer or dealer lessor reports revenue equal to the lesser of the underlying asset's fair value and the present value of the lease payments: lesser of $600,000 and $560,000 = $560,000. The unguaranteed residual is not sold; it reduces cost of goods sold instead ($450,000 − $40,000 = $410,000), so selling profit is $560,000 − $410,000 = $150,000. The $600,000 answer treats the full fair value, including the residual the lessor keeps, as revenue. The $520,000 answer subtracts the residual from revenue rather than from cost of goods sold. The $150,000 answer is the selling profit, not the revenue line.
questions.explanationJa: 製造業者・販売業者である貸手は、原資産の公正価値とリース料の現在価値のいずれか低い方を売上として計上する。$600,000と$560,000の低い方で$560,000。無保証残存資産は販売されていないため売上ではなく売上原価から控除し（$450,000 − $40,000 = $410,000）、販売利益は$560,000 − $410,000 = $150,000となる。$600,000は貸手が保持する残存資産まで含めた公正価値を売上にした誤り。$520,000は残存資産を売上原価ではなく売上から差し引いた誤り。$150,000は販売利益であり売上高ではない。

questions.subtopic: Lessor Costs Paid by the Lessee — Gross vs. Net
questions.stem: Ashton Properties' operating-lease tenant pays the property taxes directly to the county and reimburses Ashton for insurance that Ashton pays. How should Ashton report these costs?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Exclude the taxes; report the insurance gross

choices.label: B
choices.text: Report both costs gross, as lease income and expense

choices.label: C
choices.text: Exclude both, because the tenant bears each cost

choices.label: D
choices.text: Report the taxes gross; net the insurance against the reimbursement

questions.explanation: ASC 842-10-15-40A (ASU 2018-20) requires a lessor to exclude from variable payments, and therefore not report, lessor costs that the lessee pays directly to a third party, such as property taxes paid straight to the county. Lessor costs that the lessor pays and the lessee reimburses are variable payments and are reported gross: the reimbursement as lease income and the insurance as expense. Reporting both costs gross ignores the direct-payment exclusion for the taxes. Excluding both ignores that Ashton itself pays the insurance and is reimbursed. Reporting the taxes gross while netting the insurance reverses the two treatments.
questions.explanationJa: ASC 842-10-15-40A（ASU 2018-20）では、借手が第三者に直接支払う貸手コスト（郡に直接納付する固定資産税など）は変動リース料から除外し、貸手は計上しない。一方、貸手が支払い借手から払い戻しを受ける貸手コストは変動リース料として総額表示する（払戻額をリース収益、保険料を費用）。両方を総額表示する処理は、税金の直接支払に関する除外規定を無視している。両方とも除外する処理は、保険料はAshton自身が支払い払戻しを受けている点を無視している。税金を総額、保険を純額とする処理は、両者の扱いが逆である。

questions.subtopic: Sale-Leaseback — Which Feature Defeats Sale Accounting
questions.stem: Haven Corp. will sell its headquarters building to an investor and lease it back. Which feature, if present, would cause the transfer to fail as a sale?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A sale price $200,000 below fair value

choices.label: B
choices.text: Variable rent based on Haven's revenue

choices.label: C
choices.text: A renewal option that is not reasonably certain

choices.label: D
choices.text: A leaseback term of 80% of the remaining economic life

questions.explanation: A transfer in a sale-leaseback is not a sale if the leaseback would be classified as a finance lease by the seller-lessee (ASC 842-40-25-2). A lease term covering a major part (80%) of the remaining economic life meets a finance lease criterion, so the transfer fails and both parties account for a financing. A sale price below fair value does not defeat sale accounting; the difference is treated as prepaid rent. Variable rent based on the lessee's revenue does not affect whether control transferred and is not included in the lease payments. A renewal option that is not reasonably certain is excluded from the lease term, so it does not push the leaseback into finance classification.
questions.explanationJa: セール・アンド・リースバックで、売手（借手）がリースバックをファイナンス・リースに分類する場合、資産の移転は販売とならない（ASC 842-40-25-2）。リース期間が残存経済的耐用年数の大部分（80%）を占めればファイナンス・リースの要件を満たすため、販売は不成立となり、双方が金融取引として処理する。公正価値を下回る売価は販売の成否に影響せず、差額は前払賃料として扱う。借手の売上に連動する変動賃料は支配移転の判定に影響せず、リース料にも含めない。行使が合理的に確実でない更新オプションはリース期間に含めないため、ファイナンス・リース分類の根拠にならない。

questions.subtopic: Failed Sale-Leaseback — Seller-Lessee Financial Liability
questions.stem: On January 1, Year 1, Dale Co. sold equipment for $3,000,000 cash and leased it back under a lease classified as a finance lease, so the transfer failed as a sale. Dale pays $250,000 each December 31, and the applicable interest rate is 6%. What is Dale's financial liability at December 31, Year 1, after the first payment?
questions.explanation: In a failed sale, the seller-lessee keeps the equipment (and keeps depreciating it) and records the $3,000,000 received as a financial liability. Each payment is split between interest and principal: interest is $3,000,000 × 6% = $180,000, so principal reduction is $250,000 − $180,000 = $70,000, leaving $3,000,000 − $70,000 = $2,930,000. The $2,820,000 answer subtracts the interest instead of the principal portion. The $2,750,000 answer treats the whole payment as principal. The $3,000,000 answer ignores the payment entirely.
questions.explanationJa: 販売不成立の場合、売手（借手）は設備を引き続き計上して減価償却し、受け取った$3,000,000を金融負債として計上する。各支払は利息と元本に配分する。利息は$3,000,000 × 6% = $180,000、元本減少は$250,000 − $180,000 = $70,000、期末残高は$3,000,000 − $70,000 = $2,930,000。$2,820,000は元本部分ではなく利息額を差し引いた誤り。$2,750,000は支払全額を元本返済とした誤り。$3,000,000は支払を全く反映していない。

questions.subtopic: Lessor Classification — Specialized Asset vs. Third-Party Residual Guarantee
questions.stem: Pell Leasing leases equipment for 4 of its 10 years of economic life. The present value of the lease payments is 65% of fair value; there is no purchase option or title transfer. Which additional fact makes the lease sales-type?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The equipment has no alternative use to Pell after the lease

choices.label: B
choices.text: A third-party residual guarantee lifts present value to 95% of fair value

choices.label: C
choices.text: A renewal option exists but is not reasonably certain

choices.label: D
choices.text: Pell incurred large initial direct costs to arrange the lease

questions.explanation: A lessor classifies a lease as sales-type if any of the five criteria in ASC 842-10-25-2 is met. One criterion is that the underlying asset is so specialized that it is expected to have no alternative use to the lessor at the end of the lease term. A residual value guarantee from an unrelated third party is not part of the lease payments for the sales-type tests; when it brings the combined present value to substantially all of fair value (and collectibility is probable), the lease is a direct financing lease, not sales-type. A renewal option that is not reasonably certain is excluded from the lease term. Initial direct costs affect measurement, not classification.
questions.explanationJa: 貸手はASC 842-10-25-2の5要件のいずれかを満たせば販売型リースに分類する。その一つが、原資産が特殊でリース終了時に貸手にとって他の用途がないと見込まれることである。無関係の第三者による残価保証は販売型の判定上のリース料に含まれず、それによって現在価値合計が公正価値のほぼ全てに達する（かつ回収可能性が高い）場合は、販売型ではなく直接金融リースとなる。行使が合理的に確実でない更新オプションはリース期間に含めない。当初直接費用は測定に影響するが分類には影響しない。

questions.subtopic: Software to Be Sold — Costs Reported as Inventory
questions.stem: Vantage Apps develops software that it sells to customers. Which of the following costs should be reported as inventory rather than as a capitalized software asset or an expense?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Coding and testing performed after technological feasibility was established

choices.label: B
choices.text: Testing performed before technological feasibility was established

choices.label: C
choices.text: Duplicating the software from product masters and packaging it for sale

choices.label: D
choices.text: Customer support provided after the product's general release

questions.explanation: Under ASC 985-330, the costs of producing units from product masters (duplicating software, documentation, and packaging) are inventory costs and are charged to cost of sales when the units are sold. Coding and testing after technological feasibility (and before general release) is capitalized as a software asset under ASC 985-20, not inventory. Testing before technological feasibility is research and development expense. Customer support after release is expensed as incurred.
questions.explanationJa: ASC 985-330では、プロダクト・マスターからの製品複製（ソフトウェアの複製、マニュアル、梱包）のコストは棚卸資産とし、販売時に売上原価へ振り替える。技術的実現可能性の確立後（一般販売開始前）のコーディング・テストはASC 985-20によりソフトウェア資産として資産計上され、棚卸資産ではない。技術的実現可能性確立前のテストは研究開発費として費用処理する。販売開始後のカスタマーサポートは発生時に費用処理する。

questions.subtopic: Internal-Use Software — Amount Capitalized
questions.stem:
During Year 1, Talbot Co. developed software solely for internal use. Management authorized and committed funding before coding began, and completion was probable. Costs were:
Evaluating alternatives before authorization | $40,000
Coding and installation | $300,000
Testing, including parallel processing | $60,000
Data conversion and cleansing | $25,000
Employee training | $35,000
What amount should Talbot capitalize?
questions.explanation: Internal-use software costs are capitalized once management has authorized and committed funding and completion is probable; coding, installation, and testing (including parallel processing) incurred after that point are capitalized: $300,000 + $60,000 = $360,000. Evaluating alternatives before authorization is expensed. Data conversion and cleansing of old data and employee training are expensed as incurred. The $400,000 answer adds the pre-authorization evaluation costs. The $385,000 answer adds data conversion. The $460,000 answer capitalizes every cost.
questions.explanationJa: 社内利用ソフトウェアは、経営者が承認し資金拠出を確約し、完成の可能性が高くなった時点以降のコストを資産計上する。その後に発生したコーディング・導入・テスト（並行稼働を含む）が対象で、$300,000 + $60,000 = $360,000。承認前の代替案の評価は費用処理。旧データの変換・クレンジングと従業員研修も発生時に費用処理する。$400,000は承認前の評価コストを加えた誤り。$385,000はデータ変換を加えた誤り。$460,000は全コストを資産計上した誤り。

questions.subtopic: Cloud Computing Arrangement — Impairment and Presentation of Implementation Costs
questions.stem: Merritt Co. capitalized $180,000 of implementation costs for a cloud computing arrangement that is a service contract. Which statement about these capitalized costs is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: They are presented with intangible assets

choices.label: B
choices.text: They are tested for impairment as long-lived assets held and used

choices.label: C
choices.text: Their amortization is reported as depreciation and amortization

choices.label: D
choices.text: They are tested for impairment annually at fair value

questions.explanation: ASU 2018-15 requires capitalized implementation costs of a hosting arrangement that is a service contract to be evaluated for impairment under the ASC 360-10 long-lived asset (held and used) model, as if the costs were long-lived assets. They are presented in the same balance sheet line item as prepaid fees for the hosting arrangement, not with intangible assets. Their amortization is presented in the same income statement line item as the hosting fees, not as depreciation and amortization. An annual fair value test applies to goodwill and indefinite-lived intangibles, not to these costs.
questions.explanationJa: ASU 2018-15により、サービス契約であるホスティング契約の資産計上された導入コストは、長期性資産であるかのように、ASC 360-10の保有・使用資産モデルで減損を評価する。貸借対照表では無形資産ではなく、ホスティング契約の前払料金と同じ表示科目に表示する。償却費は減価償却費・償却費ではなく、ホスティング料金と同じ損益計算書の表示科目に表示する。公正価値との年次比較による減損テストはのれん・耐用年数を確定できない無形資産に適用されるもので、このコストには適用されない。

questions.subtopic: R&D Expense — Identifying Qualifying Costs
questions.stem:
Quill Labs incurred the following costs in Year 1:
Salaries of scientists searching for a new compound | $210,000
Design, construction, and testing of a prototype | $140,000
Routine quality-control testing during production | $50,000
Legal fees to file a patent | $30,000
Market research for the new product | $25,000
What amount should Quill report as research and development expense?
questions.explanation: Under ASC 730, research (searching for a new compound) and development (designing, constructing, and testing a prototype) are R&D: $210,000 + $140,000 = $350,000. Routine quality-control testing during commercial production, legal work on patent applications, and market research are specifically excluded from R&D. The $380,000 answer adds the patent legal fees. The $400,000 answer adds routine quality control. The $425,000 answer adds both quality control and market research.
questions.explanationJa: ASC 730では、研究（新化合物の探索）と開発（試作品の設計・製作・テスト）が研究開発費に該当し、$210,000 + $140,000 = $350,000。商業生産中の定常的な品質管理テスト、特許出願の法務費用、市場調査は研究開発から明示的に除外される。$380,000は特許の法務費用を加えた誤り。$400,000は定常的な品質管理を加えた誤り。$425,000は品質管理と市場調査の両方を加えた誤り。

questions.subtopic: Goodwill Impairment — Indefinite-Lived Intangible Tested First
questions.stem: Lorne Co.'s reporting unit has a carrying amount of $10,000,000, including goodwill of $2,000,000 and an indefinite-lived trademark carried at $900,000. The trademark's fair value is $700,000, and the reporting unit's fair value is $9,500,000. What goodwill impairment loss should Lorne recognize?
questions.explanation: Other assets in a reporting unit, including indefinite-lived intangibles, are tested for impairment before goodwill. The trademark is impaired by $900,000 − $700,000 = $200,000, reducing the reporting unit's carrying amount to $9,800,000. Goodwill impairment is then $9,800,000 − $9,500,000 = $300,000, which is less than the $2,000,000 goodwill balance. The $500,000 answer compares fair value with the carrying amount before the trademark write-down (it equals total impairment, not goodwill impairment). The $700,000 answer double-counts the trademark loss. The $0 answer overlooks that the adjusted carrying amount still exceeds fair value.
questions.explanationJa: 報告単位内の他の資産（耐用年数を確定できない無形資産を含む）は、のれんより先に減損テストを行う。商標の減損は$900,000 − $700,000 = $200,000で、報告単位の帳簿価額は$9,800,000になる。のれんの減損は$9,800,000 − $9,500,000 = $300,000で、のれん残高$2,000,000の範囲内。$500,000は商標の減損前の帳簿価額と比較した誤り（減損総額であり、のれん減損額ではない）。$700,000は商標の損失を二重計上した誤り。$0は修正後の帳簿価額がなお公正価値を上回る点を見落としている。

questions.subtopic: Recognition of Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets
questions.stem: Which of the following would be recognized as an indefinite-lived intangible asset?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Costs of internally developing and maintaining a well-known brand name

choices.label: B
choices.text: An assembled workforce acquired in a business combination

choices.label: C
choices.text: A customer list acquired in a business combination

choices.label: D
choices.text: An acquired broadcast license renewable indefinitely at little cost

questions.explanation: An acquired broadcast license that can be renewed indefinitely at little cost, with no limiting factors, has no foreseeable limit on its useful life and is an indefinite-lived intangible that is not amortized but is tested for impairment. Costs of internally developing and maintaining a brand that is not specifically identifiable are expensed under ASC 350-30-25-3, so no asset arises. An assembled workforce is not identifiable apart from goodwill and is subsumed into goodwill. An acquired customer list is recognized, but it has a finite life and is amortized.
questions.explanationJa: わずかなコストで無期限に更新でき、制約要因のない取得した放送免許は、耐用年数に予見可能な限度がなく、耐用年数を確定できない無形資産として償却せず減損テストの対象とする。個別に識別できない自社ブランドの開発・維持コストはASC 350-30-25-3により費用処理され、資産は生じない。集合した労働力はのれんと区別して識別できず、のれんに含める。取得した顧客リストは認識されるが、耐用年数が有限で償却する。

questions.subtopic: Performance Target Achievable After the Requisite Service Period
questions.stem: Ruston Inc. grants RSUs with a three-year service period. Shares are delivered only if a Year 4 revenue target is met, even to employees who leave after Year 3. How should Ruston treat the revenue target?

choices.label: A
choices.text: As a market condition reflected in grant-date fair value

choices.label: B
choices.text: As a performance condition recognized only if probable

choices.label: C
choices.text: As a nonvesting condition reflected in grant-date fair value

choices.label: D
choices.text: As a feature requiring liability classification

questions.explanation: Under ASC 718-10-30-28 (ASU 2014-12), a performance target that affects vesting and could be achieved after the requisite service period is a performance condition. It is not reflected in grant-date fair value; compensation cost is recognized over the service period only when it becomes probable that the target will be achieved. A revenue target is not a market condition because it is not based on the share price. Treating it as a nonvesting condition built into fair value is the approach ASU 2014-12 rejected. A revenue-based vesting target does not make an equity-settled award a liability.
questions.explanationJa: ASC 718-10-30-28（ASU 2014-12）では、権利確定に影響し、必要勤務期間後に達成され得る業績目標は業績条件として扱う。付与日公正価値には反映せず、目標達成の可能性が高くなった時点で勤務期間にわたり報酬費用を認識する。売上目標は株価に基づかないため市場条件ではない。公正価値に織り込む非権利確定条件として扱う方法はASU 2014-12で否定された。売上に基づく権利確定目標によって持分決済の報酬が負債分類になることはない。

questions.subtopic: Cash-Settled SARs — Remeasurement in Year 2
questions.stem: On January 1, Year 1, Tanner Co. granted 10,000 cash-settled stock appreciation rights that cliff-vest after three years; no forfeitures are expected. The grant-date fair value was $9 per SAR. Fair value was $8 at December 31, Year 1, and $11 at December 31, Year 2. What compensation expense should Tanner recognize for Year 2?
questions.explanation: Cash-settled SARs are liability-classified and remeasured at fair value each reporting date, with cumulative cost based on the portion of service rendered. Cumulative cost at the end of Year 2 is 10,000 × $11 × 2/3 = $73,333; cost recognized in Year 1 was 10,000 × $8 × 1/3 = $26,667; Year 2 expense is $73,333 − $26,667 = $46,667. The $73,333 answer is the cumulative amount, not the Year 2 expense. The $36,667 answer recognizes only one-third of the Year 2 fair value. The $30,000 answer uses the grant-date fair value, which applies to equity-classified awards.
questions.explanationJa: 現金決済型SARは負債分類で、各報告日に公正価値で再測定し、提供済み勤務の割合に応じて累計費用を算定する。Year 2末の累計費用は10,000 × $11 × 2/3 = $73,333、Year 1の計上額は10,000 × $8 × 1/3 = $26,667、Year 2の費用は$73,333 − $26,667 = $46,667。$73,333は累計額でありYear 2の費用ではない。$36,667はYear 2の公正価値の1/3しか計上していない。$30,000は持分分類の報酬に適用する付与日公正価値を用いた誤り。

questions.subtopic: Equity vs. Liability Classification of Awards
questions.stem: Which of the following share-based awards to employees should be classified as a liability?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Options net-share settled for withholding up to the maximum statutory rate

choices.label: B
choices.text: Shares puttable at fair value only after being held over six months

choices.label: C
choices.text: RSUs settled in a fixed number of shares at vesting

choices.label: D
choices.text: Options whose exercise price is indexed to the price of gold

questions.explanation: An award indexed to a factor that is not a market, performance, or service condition, such as a commodity price, is classified as a liability (ASC 718-10-25-13). Net share settlement for withholding up to the maximum statutory tax rate does not cause liability classification after ASU 2016-09. A put at fair value that can be exercised only after the employee has held the shares for six months or more leaves the employee bearing the risks and rewards of ownership, so the shares remain equity. RSUs settled in a fixed number of shares are equity-classified.
questions.explanationJa: 市場条件・業績条件・勤務条件のいずれでもない要因（商品価格など）に連動する報酬は負債に分類する（ASC 718-10-25-13）。法定最高税率までの源泉徴収のための純額株式決済は、ASU 2016-09以後、負債分類の原因とならない。従業員が6か月以上株式を保有した後にのみ公正価値で行使できるプットは、従業員が所有のリスクと経済価値を負うため、株式は持分のままである。固定数の株式で決済されるRSUは持分分類である。

questions.subtopic: Grant Date — Perfunctory Shareholder Approval
questions.stem: On February 1, Oakes Corp.'s board approved stock options and communicated the terms to employees. Shareholder approval is required, but the CEO controls 70% of the votes and has committed to approve; the vote is May 10. What is the grant date?

choices.label: A
choices.text: May 10, when the shareholder vote occurs

choices.label: B
choices.text: January 1, the start of the fiscal year

choices.label: C
choices.text: February 1, since approval is perfunctory

choices.label: D
choices.text: The date the options vest

questions.explanation: The grant date is when the employer and employees reach a mutual understanding of the key terms and all necessary approvals are obtained. If a required approval is essentially perfunctory, such as when management controls enough votes to approve the plan, the grant date is not delayed until the vote (ASC 718-10-25-5 and the grant date definition), so it is February 1. The May 10 answer ignores the perfunctory-approval exception. The start of the fiscal year precedes any approval or communication. The vesting date is not the grant date; uncertainty about how many options vest affects attribution, not the grant date.
questions.explanationJa: 付与日は、雇用主と従業員が主要条件について相互理解に達し、必要な承認がすべて得られた日である。必要な承認が実質的に形式的なもの（経営者が承認に十分な議決権を支配している場合など）であれば、付与日は投票日まで遅れない（ASC 718-10-25-5および付与日の定義）ため、2月1日となる。5月10日とする解答は、形式的承認の例外を無視している。会計年度の開始日は承認や通知より前である。権利確定日は付与日ではなく、確定する数の不確実性は費用配分に影響するが付与日には影響しない。

questions.subtopic: ESPP — Change That Makes a Plan Compensatory
questions.stem: Keene Co.'s employee stock purchase plan currently qualifies as noncompensatory. Which proposed change would cause the plan to become compensatory?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Raising the purchase discount from 5% to 10% without evidence of saved issuance costs

choices.label: B
choices.text: Excluding employees with less than two years of service from participating

choices.label: C
choices.text: Refunding withheld pay to employees who cancel participation before the purchase date

choices.label: D
choices.text: Capping each employee's purchases at 10% of annual salary

questions.explanation: Under ASC 718-50-25-1, an ESPP is noncompensatory only if its discount does not exceed the per-share amount of issuance costs avoided (a discount of 5% or less is presumed to meet this), substantially all employees meeting limited employment qualifications may participate, and the plan has no option features other than limited permitted ones. A 10% discount without evidence of avoided issuance costs fails the discount test. Excluding employees with short service is a permitted limited employment qualification. Refunding employees who cancel before the purchase date is a permitted feature. A purchase cap based on salary applies on an equitable basis and does not make the plan compensatory.
questions.explanationJa: ASC 718-50-25-1では、ESPPが非報酬型となるのは、割引率が回避された1株当たり発行コストを超えないこと（5%以下なら満たすと推定）、限定的な雇用資格を満たすほぼ全従業員が参加できること、許容される限定的なもの以外にオプションの特徴がないこと、の全てを満たす場合に限られる。発行コスト節減の証拠なく割引を10%にすると割引要件を満たさない。勤続年数の短い従業員の除外は許容される限定的な雇用資格である。購入日前に参加を取り消した従業員への返金は許容される特徴である。給与に基づく購入上限は公平に適用されるもので、報酬型にはならない。

questions.topic: Revenue Recognition with Data Analytics (Area II)
questions.subtopic: Analytics Output — Uniform Margin and Principal vs. Agent Evidence
questions.stem: Analytics show Delmont Retail's partner-products line earns a uniform 12% margin on every sale. Delmont reports this revenue gross. Which confirmed contract term would best support gross reporting?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The partner sets prices; Delmont keeps a fixed percentage

choices.label: B
choices.text: Delmont fulfills orders and bears inventory risk before sale

choices.label: C
choices.text: Delmont collects cash and bears customer credit risk

choices.label: D
choices.text: The partner ships directly and accepts all returns

questions.explanation: Gross reporting requires that the entity control the good before transfer, i.e., be the principal. Indicators of control under ASC 606-10-55-39 are primary responsibility for fulfillment, inventory risk before transfer, and discretion in setting prices; primary fulfillment responsibility plus inventory risk best supports gross reporting despite the analytics red flags. A fixed percentage of each sale with the partner setting prices points to an agent earning a commission. Credit risk was removed as an indicator by ASU 2016-08 and does not establish control. Direct shipment by the partner with the partner taking returns indicates the partner, not Delmont, controls the goods.
questions.explanationJa: 総額表示には、顧客への移転前に企業が財を支配していること（本人であること）が必要。ASC 606-10-55-39の支配の指標は、履行の主たる責任、移転前の在庫リスク、価格設定の裁量であり、履行の主たる責任と在庫リスクを負うことが、分析上の警告にもかかわらず総額表示を最も強く裏付ける。パートナーが価格を決め、Delmontが売上の一定割合を受け取るのは手数料を得る代理人を示す。信用リスクはASU 2016-08で指標から削除され、支配の根拠にならない。パートナーが直接出荷し返品も受けるのは、Delmontではなくパートナーが財を支配していることを示す。

questions.topic: Revenue Recognition with Data Analytics (Area II)
questions.subtopic: Analytics Output — Recurring January Credit Memos as Price Concessions
questions.stem: Analytics show that Corbin Supply's January credit memos, granted to retain key customers, have equaled about 3% of December sales for five years. Corbin recorded Year 5 December sales at invoice amounts. What is the appropriate conclusion?

choices.label: A
choices.text: No adjustment; the credit memos are nonrecognized subsequent events

choices.label: B
choices.text: Disclose the expected credit memos without adjusting revenue

choices.label: C
choices.text: Record the expected credit memos as selling expense

choices.label: D
choices.text: Reduce Year 5 revenue for expected price concessions

questions.explanation: A consistent history of granting concessions creates an implicit price concession, which is variable consideration (ASC 606-10-32-7). Corbin must estimate it when recognizing December revenue and reduce Year 5 revenue (with a refund liability), rather than waiting until the memos are issued. The credit memos reflect a condition that existed at year-end, so treating them as nonrecognized subsequent events is wrong. Disclosure alone does not correct the overstated revenue. Price concessions to customers reduce the transaction price; they are not selling expense.
questions.explanationJa: 継続的に値引きを行う慣行は黙示的な価格譲歩となり、変動対価に該当する（ASC 606-10-32-7）。Corbinは12月の収益認識時にこれを見積もり、Year 5の収益を減額（返金負債を計上）すべきで、クレジットメモ発行時まで待つことはできない。クレジットメモは期末に存在した状況を反映するため、認識しない後発事象とするのは誤り。注記開示だけでは過大な収益は修正されない。顧客への価格譲歩は取引価格の減額であり、販売費ではない。

questions.topic: Revenue Recognition with Data Analytics (Area II)
questions.subtopic: Analytics Exception — Custom Contract Recognized at a Point in Time
questions.stem: Revenue analytics at Hart Fabrication flag a custom-equipment contract with no revenue recognized at year-end. The equipment has no alternative use to Hart, and Hart has an enforceable right to payment for work to date. The price is $1,200,000; costs incurred are $450,000 of $900,000 total estimated costs. Using cost-to-cost, what Year 1 revenue should Hart recognize?
questions.explanation: An asset with no alternative use plus an enforceable right to payment for performance to date meets an over-time criterion (ASC 606-10-25-27(c)), so recognizing nothing until delivery is an error. Progress is $450,000 ÷ $900,000 = 50%, and revenue is 50% × $1,200,000 = $600,000. The $1,200,000 answer recognizes the full price before completion. The $450,000 answer equates revenue with costs incurred, which ignores the margin. The $0 answer is the point-in-time treatment the analytics flagged.
questions.explanationJa: 他に転用できない資産で、かつ現在までの履行に対する強制可能な支払請求権があれば、一定期間にわたる収益認識の要件（ASC 606-10-25-27(c)）を満たすため、引渡しまで収益をゼロとするのは誤り。進捗度は$450,000 ÷ $900,000 = 50%、収益は50% × $1,200,000 = $600,000。$1,200,000は完成前に契約価格全額を計上した誤り。$450,000は発生原価をそのまま収益とし利益分を無視した誤り。$0は分析で指摘された一時点認識の処理である。

questions.topic: Revenue Recognition with Data Analytics (Area II)
questions.subtopic: Analytics Output — Year-End Distributor Shipments and Consignment
questions.stem: Analytics show Bryce Co.'s year-end shipments to distributors rose 40% while distributors' resales were flat. Distributors pay only after reselling and may return unsold goods at any time. How should Bryce account for these shipments?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Revenue at shipment, net of a refund liability for expected returns

choices.label: B
choices.text: Consignment; revenue when distributors resell the goods

choices.label: C
choices.text: Revenue at shipment, because legal title passed

choices.label: D
choices.text: Revenue at shipment, with gross profit deferred until collection

questions.explanation: When the distributor need not pay until it resells the goods and can return unsold goods at any time, control has not transferred; the arrangement is a consignment (ASC 606-10-55-79 and 55-80). Bryce keeps the goods in inventory and recognizes revenue when the distributors sell to end customers. The refund-liability approach for rights of return applies only when control has transferred to the customer. Legal title is only one indicator and does not override the consignment terms. Deferring gross profit until collection is an installment-type method not used under ASC 606.
questions.explanationJa: 販売店が再販売するまで代金を支払う必要がなく、未販売品をいつでも返品できる場合、支配は移転しておらず委託販売契約に該当する（ASC 606-10-55-79、55-80）。Bryceは商品を棚卸資産に残し、販売店が最終顧客に販売した時点で収益を認識する。返金負債を計上する返品権付き販売の処理は、支配が顧客に移転した場合にのみ適用される。法的所有権は指標の一つにすぎず、委託販売の条件に優先しない。代金回収まで売上総利益を繰り延べる処理は割賦基準的な方法であり、ASC 606では用いない。
